messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large four-legged furry mammal standing facing right, with dense shaggy brown fur, a bear-like head with blunt muzzle, dark nose and small rounded ears, four thick bear-like legs ending in broad clawed paws, but with glossy dark reddish-brown beetle-like features: several oval shell plates on the neck, shoulder and flank, two translucent tan veined membranous insect wings spread from the sides of the body, rows of narrow slit-like openings in the fur on the hip and mid-side, and a long down-curving segmented armored tail with small spines ending in two points.", "extra_limb_pieces": 3, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "bear", "part": "head", "where": "at front of body facing right with blunt snout, dark nose and brown eyes"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "ears", "where": "two small rounded ears on top of head"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "legs", "where": "four thick fur-covered legs under the body"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "feet", "where": "broad paws at ends of legs with long pale claws"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "tail", "where": "long segmented glossy dark brown armored tail curving down from rear with spines and forked tip"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "wings", "where": "one large translucent veined wing extending from near mid-side and one smaller matching wing on far side behind front leg"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "shell", "where": "six glossy dark reddish-brown oval elytra plates on neck, shoulder, flank and far chest"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "markings", "where": "two rows of narrow slit-like openings in fur on rear hip and mid-flank"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 2}
